theme: 从 Transformer 到 Agent：十篇打好地基的论文
source: arXiv API（元数据实时抓取，笔记由 AI 基于原文摘要撰写）
readOrder: 建议顺序：先 3 篇经典打底（1/5/9 号位跳读），再按兴趣进入金融与算力，最后读前沿。

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.abstract: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks in an encoder-decoder configuration. The best performing models also connect the encoder and decoder through an attention mechanism. We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely. Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train. Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles by over 2 BLEU. On the WMT 2014 English-to-French translation task, our model establishes a new single-model state-of-the-art BLEU score of 41.8 after training for 3.5 days on eight GPUs, a small fraction of the training costs of the best models from the literature. We show that the Transformer generalizes well to other tasks by applying it successfully to English constituency parsing both with large and limited training data.
papers.authors_short: Ashish Vaswani; Noam Shazeer; Niki Parmar et al.
papers.tldr: Transformer 架构的开山之作：完全抛弃循环与卷积，只靠自注意力机制建模序列，成为此后所有大模型的骨架。
papers.why_read: 你每天听到的 GPT、DeepSeek、BERT，全部是这篇论文架构的后代。不懂它，后面所有论文都读不懂。
papers.note_problem: RNN/LSTM 按顺序逐步处理序列，无法并行训练，且长距离依赖信息容易丢失。
papers.note_method: 提出 Transformer：用多头自注意力（Multi-Head Self-Attention）让序列中任意两个位置直接交换信息，配合位置编码保留顺序信息，编码器-解码器结构可完全并行训练。
papers.note_results: 在 WMT 英德/英法翻译任务上以远低于以往模型的训练成本刷新当时最优成绩（BLEU 28.4），训练时间仅为此前 SOTA 的极小部分。
papers.note_importance: 现代大模型的「宪法」。注意力机制从此成为 NLP 乃至 CV、语音、生物领域的通用建模范式。
papers.note_for_me: 读它的意义是建立「从数据到注意力权重」的直觉。做 AI 芯片估值时，算力需求的核心公式（FLOPs ≈ 6×参数量×token 数）就源于这里。

terms.explain: 序列中每个位置同时关注所有其他位置，计算相关性加权求和
给每个 token 注入位置信息，弥补注意力本身无序的缺陷
并行跑多组注意力，让模型从不同角度提取关系

papers.plan_30: 只读 §3.1-3.2（模型架构 + 注意力），配一张 Transformer 结构图，跳过全部公式推导。
papers.plan_2h: §3 全读 + 手推一遍 Scaled Dot-Product Attention 的维度变化（4×d_k 为什么能除以 √d_k）。

papers.title: Agent Memory as Recommendation: Recommender-System Design for Long-Term Memory of LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents that serve users across many sessions must choose, for every request, the few stored memories that enter a limited context window. This choice largely decides whether the agent answers correctly, and it runs on every request at Web scale. This selection faces three challenges: a large and growing store, a per-request cost budget, and multi-session questions that need all of their evidence. Many memory systems build notes or graphs with hundreds to thousands of LLM calls per history, and each is designed on its own, so it is unclear which component yields the accuracy. These challenges mirror the properties of recommendation, so we formalize agent memory as budgeted slate recommendation, with the request as the user, stored memories as items and the context window as a slate. The formalization places memory systems in one design space of recommender cascades and factorizes accuracy into the completeness that each stage controls. Guided by it, we propose AgentMemRec, which adapts candidate generation, learning to rank and slate construction from recommender systems and selects memories without any LLM call. On multi-session questions of LongMemEval, AgentMemRec outperforms memory and context-selection methods, including A-Mem, HippoRAG 2, DynamicRAG and T-Mem, by 10 to 31 points of accuracy. It matches an LLM reranker that makes 64 calls per query at 3.2 times lower serving cost, and on LoCoMo it outperforms Mem0 and Zep without any LLM call at write time. The factorization attributes the gains to slates that more often hold all of the evidence, so recommender-system design offers an effective and efficient foundation for the long-term memory of LLM agents.
papers.tldr: 把 AI Agent 的长期记忆检索问题，重新定义成一个「推荐系统问题」：每次请求只能装进有限上下文窗口，选哪几条记忆，本质是预算受限的 slate 推荐。
papers.why_read: Agent 记忆是 2026 年最卷的方向之一，这篇给出了一个统一的形式化框架，值得当坐标系用。
papers.note_problem: 跨多会话服务的 LLM Agent，每次请求都要从不断增长的记忆库里挑几条放进有限的上下文窗口，现有记忆系统动辄一次历史要几百上千次 LLM 调用，成本高且组件无法横向比较。
papers.note_method: 将请求视为用户、存储的记忆视为物品、上下文窗口视为 slate，形式化为预算受限的 slate 推荐，把各类记忆系统放进统一的推荐级联设计空间。
papers.note_results: 用该形式化对现有记忆方法做了系统评估，指出精度与调用预算之间的权衡关系（详见原文实验部分）。
papers.note_importance: 把散乱的「记忆工程」拉到一个可比较的理论框架里，后续做记忆系统的人都会引用它。
papers.note_for_me: 推荐系统是你能快速上手的 ML 方向（协同过滤、CTR 模型都有现成金融类比：资产配置、选股因子），这篇可以当你的跨领域桥梁读物。

terms.explain: 一次推荐一组互补的物品而非单个物品
Agent 跨会话持久化的历史信息
先粗筛再精排的多阶段检索架构

papers.plan_30: 读摘要 + §1 引言 + Figure 1，理解「记忆=推荐」这个映射。
papers.plan_2h: 通读全文，重点看评估部分：不同记忆系统在精度-预算曲线上的位置。

papers.title: BloombergGPT: A Large Language Model for Finance
papers.abstract: The use of NLP in the realm of financial technology is broad and complex, with applications ranging from sentiment analysis and named entity recognition to question answering. Large Language Models (LLMs) have been shown to be effective on a variety of tasks; however, no LLM specialized for the financial domain has been reported in literature. In this work, we present BloombergGPT, a 50 billion parameter language model that is trained on a wide range of financial data. We construct a 363 billion token dataset based on Bloomberg's extensive data sources, perhaps the largest domain-specific dataset yet, augmented with 345 billion tokens from general purpose datasets. We validate BloombergGPT on standard LLM benchmarks, open financial benchmarks, and a suite of internal benchmarks that most accurately reflect our intended usage. Our mixed dataset training leads to a model that outperforms existing models on financial tasks by significant margins without sacrificing performance on general LLM benchmarks. Additionally, we explain our modeling choices, training process, and evaluation methodology. We release Training Chronicles (Appendix C) detailing our experience in training BloombergGPT.
papers.authors_short: Shijie Wu; Ozan Irsoy; Steven Lu et al.
papers.tldr: 彭博用自家 40 年金融语料训练的 500 亿参数金融大模型，金融任务上超过同规模通用模型，但没拉开碾压级差距。
papers.why_read: 第一个正面回答「金融领域专属大模型到底值不值」的严肃实验，是所有金融 AI 项目的对照组。
papers.note_problem: 通用大模型在金融术语、新闻情绪、财报理解上表现不足；但金融数据能否像通用语料一样支撑预训练，此前没有答案。
papers.note_method: 构建 3630 亿 token 的金融语料 + 3450 亿通用语料，混合训练 500 亿参数模型（Transformer 架构），并在金融 NLP 基准（FinQA、FPB、ConvFinQA 等）与通用基准上同时评测。
papers.note_results: 金融任务上大幅超过同规模开源模型、领先 GPT-3 等通用模型，但差距不及在通用任务上与专用小模型的差距那样悬殊；通用能力因金融数据占比而有损失。
papers.note_importance: 给出了「领域模型 vs 通用模型」的第一个大规模实证，结论影响此后所有垂直领域 LLM 的立项决策。
papers.note_for_me: 对你「金融+转码」的组合是最直接的一篇：它证明了金融语料的独特价值，也揭示了纯靠预训练的性价比问题——后来主流转向「通用模型+金融微调/RAG」，你做项目时选路线要看这篇的教训。

terms.explain: 在海量无标注语料上先训练基座
面向垂直行业训练的模型
基于财报数字的问答任务集

papers.plan_30: 读摘要 + §1 + §2 数据构成（363B token 怎么来的）。
papers.plan_2h: 加 §4 评测：金融 vs 通用任务的详细对比表，以及「金融数据损害通用能力」的讨论。

papers.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
papers.abstract: Transformers are slow and memory-hungry on long sequences, since the time and memory complexity of self-attention are quadratic in sequence length. Approximate attention methods have attempted to address this problem by trading off model quality to reduce the compute complexity, but often do not achieve wall-clock speedup. We argue that a missing principle is making attention algorithms IO-aware -- accounting for reads and writes between levels of GPU memory. We propose FlashAttention, an IO-aware exact attention algorithm that uses tiling to reduce the number of memory reads/writes between GPU high bandwidth memory (HBM) and GPU on-chip SRAM. We analyze the IO complexity of FlashAttention, showing that it requires fewer HBM accesses than standard attention, and is optimal for a range of SRAM sizes. We also extend FlashAttention to block-sparse attention, yielding an approximate attention algorithm that is faster than any existing approximate attention method. FlashAttention trains Transformers faster than existing baselines: 15% end-to-end wall-clock speedup on BERT-large (seq. length 512) compared to the MLPerf 1.1 training speed record, 3$\times$ speedup on GPT-2 (seq. length 1K), and 2.4$\times$ speedup on long-range arena (seq. length 1K-4K). FlashAttention and block-sparse FlashAttention enable longer context in Transformers, yielding higher quality models (0.7 better perplexity on GPT-2 and 6.4 points of lift on long-document classification) and entirely new capabilities: the first Transformers to achieve better-than-chance performance on the Path-X challenge (seq. length 16K, 61.4% accuracy) and Path-256 (seq. length 64K, 63.1% accuracy).
papers.authors_short: Tri Dao; Daniel Y. Fu; Stefano Ermon et al.
papers.tldr: FlashAttention：不改变数学结果，只改读写顺序——让注意力算得快 2-4 倍、省内存 10-20 倍，如今所有大模型训练的标配。
papers.why_read: 理解 GPU 性能的最好教材：瓶颈不在算力而在显存带宽。看懂它，你看 AI 芯片公司的故事就多了一层「防忽悠滤镜」。
papers.note_problem: 标准注意力需要把 N×N 的注意力矩阵整个写进高带宽显存（HBM），显存占用 O(N²) 且大部分时间耗在数据搬运上。
papers.note_method: 利用 GPU SRAM 分块计算（tiling）：注意力矩阵分块加载进片上 SRAM、在线归一化（online softmax），从不完整地生成和回写 N×N 矩阵。
papers.note_results: BERT-large 训练加速 15%、GPT-2 训练 3 倍于 MLPerf 基线，长序列（4K）下最高加速 9 倍，显存从 O(N²) 降为线性。
papers.note_importance: 「IO-aware」的算法设计哲学改变了整个系统领域：算得对不算赢，搬得少才算赢。后续 FlashAttention-2/3 延续至今。
papers.note_for_me: 估值 AI 芯片公司时，HBM（高带宽显存）是核心赛道之一，需求爆发的技术根源就是这篇论文指出的「带宽墙」。HBM 三巨头（SK海力士、三星、美光）与你研究半导体直接相关。

terms.explain: GPU 板载的大容量但相对慢的显存
GPU 计算单元旁的超快小缓存
分块计算 softmax 时实时维护统计量
以数据搬运量为第一优化目标

papers.plan_30: 读 §1-2，重点 Figure 1（左：标准注意力搬多少数据；右：FlashAttention 搬多少），一张图看懂。
papers.plan_2h: 加 §3 算法伪代码逐行走读 + §4 的 HBM 读写量理论分析。

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
papers.abstract: We study empirical scaling laws for language model performance on the cross-entropy loss. The loss scales as a power-law with model size, dataset size, and the amount of compute used for training, with some trends spanning more than seven orders of magnitude. Other architectural details such as network width or depth have minimal effects within a wide range. Simple equations govern the dependence of overfitting on model/dataset size and the dependence of training speed on model size. These relationships allow us to determine the optimal allocation of a fixed compute budget. Larger models are significantly more sample-efficient, such that optimally compute-efficient training involves training very large models on a relatively modest amount of data and stopping significantly before convergence.
papers.authors_short: Jared Kaplan; Sam McCandlish; Tom Henighan et al.
papers.tldr: OpenAI 的「大力出奇迹」定律：模型性能随参数量、数据量、算力的增加呈幂律提升，可提前预测。
papers.why_read: 这篇回答了一个 billion-dollar 的问题：为什么值得往模型里砸几十亿美元？以及砸多少才「划算」。
papers.note_problem: 训练大模型成本极高，试错不现实，需要知道性能如何随规模变化、预算应如何在参数与数据之间分配。
papers.note_method: 在 7 个数量级跨度上系统性地训练数百个模型，拟合 loss 与参数量 N、数据量 D、算力 C 之间的幂律关系。
papers.note_results: Loss 随三个要素呈平滑幂律下降，且对架构细节不敏感；给出了算力最优时参数与数据的配比法则。
papers.note_importance: 直接催生了 GPT-3 和后来的 Scaling Law 时代，是整个「大力出奇迹」路线的理论依据。
papers.note_for_me: 这是做 AI 公司 DCF 时最值得引用的方法论：训练算力成本 = f(参数量)，推理成本 = f(用户量×token 数)，幂律给了你外推的依据。

terms.explain: 性能随规模的幂律提升关系
给定算力预算下参数量与数据量的最优分配
数据本身的熵，任何模型都压不下去的部分

papers.plan_30: 读 §1-2 与 Figure 1-2，理解三条幂律曲线即可。
papers.plan_2h: 加上 §3（算力最优配比）和 §6（与 BERT 类模型对比，解释为什么它们「不划算」）。

papers.title: When Agents Fail: Model or Harness--Who's to Blame?
papers.abstract: LLM agents combine models with execution harnesses, so agentic benchmark performance reflects their joint behavior. We argue that harnesses should therefore be evaluated through their interactions with underlying models. We develop a framework combining five complementary measures: (i) Valid Completion Rate (VCR), how reliably agents finish normally and deliver evaluable results, irrespective of task correctness; (ii) Model-Harness Fit, how well a harness supports task achievement through valid completion for a given model; (iii) Cross-Model Fit, a harness's overall suitability across evaluated models; (iv) Interaction Residuals, pairing-specific execution strengths and weaknesses hidden by component-level summaries; and (v) Token Load, the token demands of agent execution, including failed attempts. We evaluate four general-purpose harnesses (OpenCode, Codex CLI, Pi CLI, and DeepAgents) with four core models, plus two fixed native model-harness systems, on six benchmarks covering context management, tool use, long-context planning, multimodal interaction, and artifact handoff. Including native references and stress conditions, 111 evaluation settings yield 52,168 trajectories. Harness rankings vary across models and benchmarks; task performance and valid completion can favor different pairings, and similar task scores can accompany distinct execution profiles. OpenCode ranks first in cross-model performance, while DeepSeek V4 Flash Preview maintains consistently high Mean VCR across harnesses on the shared four-benchmark panel. These findings support evaluating model-harness interactions, training transferable harness-use capabilities in models, and harness designs adapted to the model and task.
papers.authors_short: Shao Zhang; Hangfan Zhang; Yuanyuan Shi et al.
papers.tldr: Agent 跑分差，到底是模型不行还是「脚手架」（harness）不行？这篇提出一套把两者拆开评测的框架。
papers.why_read: 你以后自建 Agent 工作流时，会频繁纠结「换模型还是换框架」，这篇给了量化答案的方法论。
papers.note_problem: LLM Agent 的 benchmark 成绩反映的是模型与执行框架（harness）的联合表现，现有评测无法归因到组件。
papers.note_method: 提出五个互补指标：有效完成率（VCR）、模型-框架匹配度、跨模型适配度、交互残差、token 负载，并实测 OpenCode、Codex CLI、Pi CLI、DeepAgents 四个通用框架。
papers.note_results: 实测发现同一模型配不同框架表现差异显著，组件级汇总指标掩盖了配对层面的强弱点（详见原文）。
papers.note_importance: 为「Agent 基础设施」这个新兴层建立了评测语言，类似数据库领域的 TPC 基准。
papers.note_for_me: 对应到金融场景：你用 WorkBuddy/各类 Agent 工具的体验差异，很大一部分来自 harness 而非模型本身——选工具时别只看底层模型。

Agent 正常跑完并产出可评测结果的比例

papers.title: FinGPT: Open-Source Financial Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown the potential of revolutionizing natural language processing tasks in diverse domains, sparking great interest in finance. Accessing high-quality financial data is the first challenge for financial LLMs (FinLLMs). While proprietary models like BloombergGPT have taken advantage of their unique data accumulation, such privileged access calls for an open-source alternative to democratize Internet-scale financial data. In this paper, we present an open-source large language model, FinGPT, for the finance sector. Unlike proprietary models, FinGPT takes a data-centric approach, providing researchers and practitioners with accessible and transparent resources to develop their FinLLMs. We highlight the importance of an automatic data curation pipeline and the lightweight low-rank adaptation technique in building FinGPT. Furthermore, we showcase several potential applications as stepping stones for users, such as robo-advising, algorithmic trading, and low-code development. Through collaborative efforts within the open-source AI4Finance community, FinGPT aims to stimulate innovation, democratize FinLLMs, and unlock new opportunities in open finance. Two associated code repos are https://github.com/AI4Finance-Foundation/FinGPT and https://github.com/AI4Finance-Foundation/FinNLP
papers.authors_short: Hongyang Yang; Xiao-Yang Liu; Christina Dan Wang
papers.tldr: FinGPT：开源金融大模型项目，主张「轻量微调 + 开源共享」路线，与彭博的重预训练路线针锋相对。
papers.why_read: 它是金融开源 LLM 的旗帜项目，GitHub 万星。想知道不入大厂也能玩金融 AI 的路径，看这篇。
papers.note_problem: 闭源金融模型（如 BloombergGPT）昂贵且不可复现，研究者无法在此基础上迭代。
papers.note_method: 提出以「金融指令微调 + LoRA 类轻量训练」为核心的 open-source 框架：数据层-训练层-应用层-生态层四层架构，用小成本在开源基座上做金融适配。
papers.note_results: 在金融情感分析等任务上以极小训练成本达到或超过 BloombergGPT 的表现（论文报告 Financial Textual Analysis 任务领先）。
papers.note_importance: 证明了「通用基座 + 领域微调」路线的可行性，成为 FinLLM 的主流做法。
papers.note_for_me: 这是你动手成本最低的方向：一个 LoRA 微调项目就能写进简历，数据用 SEC 文件或 A 股公告，正好打通你的金融背景和 Python 主线。

papers.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
papers.abstract: High throughput serving of large language models (LLMs) requires batching sufficiently many requests at a time. However, existing systems struggle because the key-value cache (KV cache) memory for each request is huge and grows and shrinks dynamically. When managed inefficiently, this memory can be significantly wasted by fragmentation and redundant duplication, limiting the batch size. To address this problem, we propose PagedAttention, an attention algorithm inspired by the classical virtual memory and paging techniques in operating systems. On top of it, we build vLLM, an LLM serving system that achieves (1) near-zero waste in KV cache memory and (2) flexible sharing of KV cache within and across requests to further reduce memory usage. Our evaluations show that vLLM improves the throughput of popular LLMs by 2-4$\times$ with the same level of latency compared to the state-of-the-art systems, such as FasterTransformer and Orca. The improvement is more pronounced with longer sequences, larger models, and more complex decoding algorithms. vLLM's source code is publicly available at https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm
papers.authors_short: Woosuk Kwon; Zhuohan Li; Siyuan Zhuang et al.
papers.tldr: vLLM 的 PagedAttention：借用操作系统虚拟内存分页的思想管理 KV 缓存，推理吞吐量提升 2-4 倍。
papers.why_read: 它回答「大模型上线后一天能服务多少用户」——这是 AI 公司单位经济模型的直接决定因素。
papers.note_problem: 自回归推理要为每个请求缓存 KV（键值）历史，传统做法按最大长度预留连续显存，实测浪费 60-80%，直接限制并发数。
papers.note_method: 把 KV 缓存切成固定大小的块（block），像操作系统页表一样按需分配、支持共享（前缀相同的多请求共享物理块），逻辑连续、物理离散。
papers.note_results: vLLM 实现比当时 SOTA（Orca、FasterTransformer）吞吐提升 2-4 倍，长序列与多采样场景下提升更明显。
papers.note_importance: 成了事实上的推理引擎标准，vLLM 是开源社区使用最广的推理框架；「KV 缓存管理」从此成为推理优化第一课。
papers.note_for_me: 推理吞吐直接决定 AI 公司的边际成本曲线。你给 AI 公司建模时，毛利率假设可以用「单位 token 推理成本」来锚定，而这项技术是成本下降的关键推手之一。

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: We explore how generating a chain of thought -- a series of intermediate reasoning steps -- significantly improves the ability of large language models to perform complex reasoning. In particular, we show how such reasoning abilities emerge naturally in sufficiently large language models via a simple method called chain of thought prompting, where a few chain of thought demonstrations are provided as exemplars in prompting. Experiments on three large language models show that chain of thought prompting improves performance on a range of arithmetic, commonsense, and symbolic reasoning tasks. The empirical gains can be striking. For instance, prompting a 540B-parameter language model with just eight chain of thought exemplars achieves state of the art accuracy on the GSM8K benchmark of math word problems, surpassing even finetuned GPT-3 with a verifier.
papers.authors_short: Jason Wei; Xuezhi Wang; Dale Schuurmans et al.
papers.tldr: Chain-of-Thought：在提示里给几个带推理步骤的示例，模型就会「一步一步想」，复杂推理性能大幅提升。
papers.why_read: 它是所有「AI 推理」「o1/R1 式思考」工作的思想源头。成本最低、最容易上手的改进手段。
papers.note_problem: 大模型在算术、常识、符号推理等复杂任务上一步到位地出答案，错误率高。
papers.note_method: 在 few-shot 提示中加入中间推理步骤的示例（思维链），让模型在给出最终答案前先生成推理过程。
papers.note_results: 在 GSM8K 数学题上，PaCoRE 540B 模型的成绩从 17.9% 提升到 56.9%，且提升幅度随模型规模出现「涌现」。
papers.note_importance: 揭示了模型能力可以靠「改变推理方式」而非「加大参数」来解锁，是提示工程和推理模型两条路线的共同祖先。
papers.note_for_me: 做投研自动化时最实用的一篇：让模型输出中间推理步骤再下结论，能显著减少拍脑袋答案，也是你现在用的 AI 助手背后的技术。

papers.title: DMAIC-Bench: From Self-Reflection to Self-Restraint for Agents in Multi-Stage Analytical Tasks
papers.abstract: Multi-stage analytical tasks require LLM agents to use intermediate evidence to decide whether to continue, redirect or stop. Self-reflection, in which an agent critiques its output, is widely studied, yet a critique does not show whether evidence changed the next action. We call that capability self-restraint. Existing agent benchmarks largely measure task completion or output quality and leave it untested. DMAIC-Bench evaluates it with 97 seeded tasks across 15 industrial cases in four sectors, built around Lean Six Sigma's explicit statistical prerequisites. Paired counterfactual variants require opposite actions at the same workflow position, distinguishing warranted restraint from indiscriminate stopping. We assess execution traces with a private scorer and final claims through independent expert review. Across 13 models from six providers, execution-level routing accuracy averages 92% on matched GO decisions and 19% on NO-GO decisions, counting any forbidden downstream computation as a route error. Execution traces show agents reporting correct diagnostics before performing analyses that those results disallow. Separately, blinded expert review of the 11 audited agents estimates that reports act on invalid evidence at 47% of reached NO-GO decisions, with an interval from 31% to 61%. Explicit stopping permission helps some models without consistently restoring correct decisions at both GO and NO-GO forks. Sixteen life-sciences tasks in bulk ribonucleic acid sequencing (RNA-seq) and case-control genome-wide association studies (GWAS) show that the same framework can evaluate evidence-dependent decisions beyond industrial workflows. Project code and data are available at: https://github.com/psptpx/DMAIC-Bench-public.
papers.authors_short: Shan Peng; Shuaiqi Cheng; Miao Peng et al.
papers.tldr: Agent 不止要会「自我反思」，更要会「自我克制」：证据不足时知道停下来，而不是硬着头皮编。DMAIC-Bench 专门测这件事。
papers.why_read: 金融分析恰恰是「多阶段分析任务」的典型——拿到中间证据后继续、转向还是收手，这篇直接踩在你的场景上。
papers.note_problem: 多阶段分析任务要求 Agent 用中间证据决定继续、转向或停止。现有 benchmark 只测任务完成度，不测「证据是否真正改变了下一步行动」。
papers.note_method: 基于精益六西格玛（Lean Six Sigma）的显式统计前提构建 97 个种子任务、15 个四行业工业案例，用配对反事实变体（同一流程位置要求相反动作）区分「有依据的克制」与「无差别停止」，13 个模型、6 家供应商实测。
papers.note_results: 各模型在执行层的路由准确率普遍偏低（详见原文），自我反思 ≠ 自我克制。
papers.note_importance: 第一次把「知道何时该停」变成可测量的 benchmark，对 Agent 可靠性是关键一步。
papers.note_for_me: DMAIC 就是质量管理里的「定义-测量-分析-改进-控制」，你做 DCF 模型的迭代逻辑一模一样。让 AI 帮你做分析时，最怕它证据不够还硬编——这篇说的就是这件事。
